title_pt: Inventário e elegibilidade das máquinas Arc
title_en: Inventory and eligibility of Arc machines
criterion_en: Informational: baseline for the other controls.

title_pt: Serviço Arc por tipo de ambiente
criterion_en: Evidence: decision recorded per source.

title_pt: Landing zone e organização de recursos
criterion_en: Evidence: approved design.
Evidence: list of servers per tier and controls per tier.

title_pt: Região dos metadados e residência de dados
criterion_en: WARN if any machine is outside the allowed regions; INFO without a list.
INFO when any recommended tag is missing; N/A without a list.
FAIL if HybridCompute, GuestConfiguration, or HybridConnectivity are not registered; WARN for the recommended ones.

title_pt: Atribuições de Azure Policy e baseline
criterion_en: WARN if no assignment relates to Arc/security; reports those in DoNotEnforce.
WARN if there is noncompliance.
WARN if there is direct Owner/UAA/RBAC Admin for a user.
WARN if the onboarding role is assigned to a user.
FAIL if there is a privileged role: the local administrator of the machine inherits this access in Azure.

title_pt: Modelo de identidade, PIM e revisão de acesso
title_en: Identity model, PIM, and access review
criterion_en: Evidence: group matrix and PIM configuration.
Evidence: rotation procedure and storage location.
WARN for a definite baseline gap; PARTIAL when a required property is null/absent and no PASS/WARN conclusion is possible. Null/absent is never treated as false.
Evidence: RBAC on both sides and approval flow.
Informational: compare with the connectivity decision.

title_pt: Acesso público do Private Link Scope
criterion_en: FAIL if any scope allows public access; N/A without Private Link.
WARN if there is Private Link without the zones in scope (they may be in the hub).

title_pt: Decisão de conectividade e liberações de rede
criterion_en: Evidence: approved decision and firewall/proxy rules.
WARN if there are open ports.
Informational.
FAIL when at least half of applicable machines accept any extension; WARN when a smaller subset does; PASS when every applicable machine has an allowlist or blocklist.
WARN: review the need and who can use them.
Informational: validate scope and use of groups.

title_pt: Run Command e Admin Center por tier
title_en: Run Command and Admin Center per tier
criterion_en: Evidence: approved decision and applied control (allowlist/RBAC).
WARN if disabled (no policy auditing inside the OS).

scenario_pt: Versões, patches e segurança do ciclo de vida
criterion_en: FAIL if not Succeeded.

title_pt: Versão do agente dentro do suporte
scenario_pt: Versões, patches e segurança do ciclo de vida
criterion_en: FAIL if any agent is out of support; WARN if supported but older than 6 months. FAIL also for versions earlier than 1.61.

title_pt: Versões e atualização automática das extensões
scenario_pt: Versões, patches e segurança do ciclo de vida
criterion_en: FAIL if the SQL extension or the Azure Monitor Agent is out of support; WARN if any extension is behind the published version (or the newest in the estate) or without automatic upgrade.
FAIL if Free.

title_pt: Extensão MDE implantada pelo Azure Arc
criterion_en: WARN if there are machines without the sensor via Arc.
FAIL when any Arc recommendation with affected machines has High severity; WARN when recommendations exist only below High; PASS when none affects an Arc machine.

title_pt: SQL Server: Defender for SQL e menor privilégio
title_en: SQL Server: Defender for SQL and least privilege
criterion_en: WARN if any of these cases occur; N/A without SQL.

title_pt: Contas locais e GPO do HIMDS
criterion_en: Evidence: GPO/local configuration on a sample.

title_pt: Coleta local em amostra (agente e serviços)
title_en: Local collection on a sample (agent and services)
criterion_en: Evidence: outputs attached to the package.
FAIL if there is Disconnected/Expired. Expired requires a new onboarding; a disconnected machine does not receive policies, patches, or extensions.
Informational.
FAIL when no connected machine has AMA; WARN when only part of the connected estate lacks AMA; PASS when all connected machines have AMA.
WARN: agent installed without collecting data.

title_pt: Microsoft Sentinel e cobertura das máquinas
criterion_en: FAIL when Sentinel exists in the collected scope but no Arc machine sends events to it; WARN when Sentinel is not found and an external SOC dependency is unresolved; INFO with measured coverage.

scenario_pt: Versões, patches e segurança do ciclo de vida
criterion_en: FAIL for pending critical/security patches or a failed patch extension; PARTIAL when assessment/authority is unknown; PASS only with one valid canonical assessment row per connected machine and no pending critical/security patches.
FAIL if there is no export (native retention of 90 days).
WARN if there are Run Command operations or removals: review author and justification.
WARN if less than 90 days.
Evidence: pilot report.
Evidence: approved plan.
Evidence: versioned script and method per environment.
Evidence: documented procedure.

title_pt: KPIs de saúde e revisão periódica
criterion_en: Evidence: dashboard and review cadence.

title_pt: Legado, fim de suporte e ESU
title_en: Legacy, end of support, and ESU
scenario_pt: Versões, patches e segurança do ciclo de vida
criterion_en: FAIL if there is 2008/2012/2012 R2 after ESU ends; WARN if there is 2016 without an assigned ESU or with an agent earlier than 1.62.

title_pt: Exceções de legado e plano de saída
scenario_pt: Versões, patches e segurança do ciclo de vida
criterion_en: Evidence: approved exception register and roadmap.

title_pt: Custo: serviços cobrados e benefícios por máquina
title_en: Cost: billed services and benefits per machine
scenario_pt: Custos, licenciamento e direitos de serviço
criterion_en: INFO with the estimate; WARN if any Windows Server pays for Update Manager/Machine Configuration without an attested benefit (opportunity if there is Software Assurance).
FAIL if there is an active High alert; WARN if there is an active alert or a High/Critical vulnerability; the Secure Score is informational.

title_pt: Baseline de segurança do sistema operacional
criterion_en: FAIL if a connected machine has no baseline assigned; WARN if a machine is non-compliant; PASS if all are assigned and compliant.

FAIL when no connected Windows machine has the local-administrators audit; WARN for non-compliance when audit coverage exists; INFO when only part of the estate is covered; PASS when all applicable machines are audited and compliant.
FAIL if a high or medium severity endpoint protection recommendation has Unhealthy machines; WARN if there is a low severity recommendation or a connected machine without the MDE extension.
FAIL when every connected machine lacks both performance and security-event telemetry; WARN when any connected machine is blind; INFO with the telemetry matrix when coverage exists.

title_pt: Mapa de recursos do Arc em uso
title_en: Map of Arc capabilities in use
scenario_pt: Custos, licenciamento e direitos de serviço
criterion_en: Informational: shows what is in use and what is available but unused.
Evidence: Windows LAPS policy applied (GPO or Intune) and a sample of servers with a managed password.
Evidence: BitLocker/dm-crypt active on the OS volume of Arc machines or a recorded exception.

title_pt: Acesso Condicional e MFA para quem administra o Azure
title_en: Conditional Access and MFA for Azure administrators
criterion_en: Evidence: Conditional Access policy for Azure management covering the accounts with roles in the Arc scope.

title_pt: Defender for Servers por máquina Arc
title_en: Defender for Servers per Arc machine
criterion_en: FAIL if any machine has no Defender for Servers (Free); WARN if the machine plan differs from the subscription plan; PASS if all machines inherit the subscription plan.

title_pt: SQL Server: licença e envio de uso (faturamento)
title_en: SQL Server: license and usage upload (billing)
scenario_pt: Custos, licenciamento e direitos de serviço
criterion_en: FAIL for a conclusive technical upload/connection/extension condition even when contractual entitlement coverage is PARTIAL; WARN for license metadata mismatches; N/A without the SQL extension.
